thread:
maya: quick sync on the capacity control card — on a 1280px canvas it feels visually heavy. we have min/max steppers, a burst toggle with details, pool selector, SLO slider, and a live cost badge all in one row. main concerns: visual scanning, keyboard nav, and SR announcements. propose a default "condensed" mode where burst details are tucked into a popover and pool shows as a single-line chip; expand on click or if the user is in trial mode.
jordan: condensed-by-default seems good but worried new users won't notice burst. idea: persist the expanded/condensed preference per user and show a subtle "show more" hint on first visit (tiny toast). i'll mock both states. :sparkles:
liam: engineering notes: per-user preference is straightforward. popover needs a focus trap and esc behavior so focus returns to the burst toggle. use aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the toggle and link via aria-controls to the popover region. SR should announce currently selected SLO value when slider changes.
sophia: product POV: default expanded for trial accounts, condensed for heavy users (heuristic: total requests/day > 10k). microcopy suggestion: change "Burst" label to "Burst capacity (temporary)" and add a short helper under min/max: "Min/Max are targets; autoscale may momentarily exceed during bursts." keep it short for localization.
maya: yep keep microcopy concise. accessibility nits: the slider needs an accessible live region readout and the numeric SLO bubble visible while dragging. pool selector tooltip should include GPU type, region, and median latency. also ensure color contrast of filled slider meets 4.5:1.
jordan: small copy nit: consider "Temporary burst" vs "Burst capacity (temporary)" — which reads better in small badges? also keyboard order should be: min -> max -> burst -> pool -> slo. we'll mirror DOM order to match tab flow.
alex: implementation suggestions: keep DOM order equal to visual order; make interactive elements tabindex=0. for the burst popover ensure Enter/Space toggles and Esc closes. small CSS utils we reuse:
```
.capacity-card .stepper button { min-width: 40px; min-height: 40px; }
.slo-slider[aria-valuenow]::after { content: attr(aria-valuenow); position: absolute; }
```
and aria-labels: "increase min instances", "decrease max instances".
liam: localization note: microcopy must be under ~50 chars in the badge/helper to avoid truncation in some locales. i'll add a lint rule to check string length for those keys.
maya: action items: jordan to deliver both condensed/expanded mocks + a11y annotations; alex to add keyboard behavior to dev notes; liam to spike focus trap and give an estimate; sophia to confirm the usage threshold and badge copy. i'll open a small ticket for the copy and aria work.
design-bot: created ticket <https://redwood.app/t/RED-4587|RED-4587> "Capacity controls: condensed default, SLO/a11y fixes, keyboard flow" :white_check_mark:  \\njordan: will post mocks and an a11y checklist by EOD. @maya please review when ready. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — let's keep the condensed pattern consistent across other compact toolbar cards too.
